name: Tustin Police Explorer Post 615
what_you_do: Get an inside look at police work. You can ride along with officers, see K-9 work and get firearms training.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 21. If you are 14, you must have finished 8th grade. You must keep a 2.0 GPA, pass an oral interview and a background check, and show good judgment.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Meetings are held every Wednesday at 6 p.m.
how_to_apply: Go to three meetings in a row. Take part in an oral interview at the third meeting. Call 714-573-3197 or email Explorers@tustinca.org with questions.
notes: You must finish an explorer academy in your first year. The page lists two phone numbers, 714-573-3197 and 714-573-3297. Confirm the number before you call.
